current_state.zh: Kraken 已关闭阿联酋居民客户的七项资产提现，剩余余额将于9月15日至25日清算，清算所得币种未确定。
current_state.en: Kraken has closed withdrawals for seven assets for UAE-resident clients, with remaining balances scheduled for liquidation Sept. 15–25 and proceeds currency unspecified.

updates.what_changed_zh: Kraken 针对阿联酋居民客户的七项资产（XMR、ZEC、DASH、USDD、DAI、USDS、USDE）提现于9月14日14:00 UTC关闭，清算窗口为9月15日至25日，且不保证清算所得币种。
updates.what_changed_en: Kraken's withdrawal cutoff for seven assets (XMR, ZEC, DASH, USDD, DAI, USDS, USDE) for UAE-resident clients is Sept. 14 at 14:00 UTC, with liquidation scheduled Sept. 15–25 and no guaranteed proceeds currency.

updates.current_state_en: Kraken has closed withdrawals for seven assets for UAE-resident clients, with remaining balances scheduled for liquidation Sept. 15–25 and proceeds currency unspecified.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kraken will close withdrawals for seven crypto assets held by UAE-resident clients on Sept. 14 and liquidate remaining balances between Sept. 15–25, 2026, without guaranteeing the currency of proceeds.
